Bill.BriefDescription: Providing public access to county law libraries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public access to county law libraries; andamending RCW 27.24.067 and 27.24.068.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 27.24.067 and 1992 c 62 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The use of the county law library shall be free to the judges ofthe state, to state and county officials, ((and)) to members of thebar, to residents of the county, and to such others as the board oftrustees may by rule provide. ((Residents of counties with apopulation of three hundred thousand or more shall have free use of thelaw library.))

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 27.24.068 and 1991 c 363 s 19 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In each county with a population of less than eight thousand, theremay be a county law library which shall be governed and maintained bythe prosecuting attorney who shall also serve as trustee of suchlibrary without additional salary or other compensation. p. 1 HB 1317 The use of the county law library shall be free to the judges ofthe state, to state and county officials, ((and)) to members of thebar, to residents of the county, and to such others as the prosecutingattorney may by rule provide.
